properties.name: help_line
properties.comment: The control's help line (help system study, section 4): one sentence for What's This, the window help card and the contents. A program value a language file's help-line translates. A value check_locale_value refuses throws std::invalid_argument, changing nothing.
hand: a view onto the control's lazily made help record (help_fields_), so a control without help pays one pointer; write_view checks the value as the locale file's reader does (check_locale_value)

properties.name: help
properties.comment: The control's full help body: one markdown string in the stx_rtf2md dialect, with stable-ID topic links. A program value a language file's help translates. A value check_locale_value refuses throws std::invalid_argument, changing nothing.
hand: a view onto the control's lazily made help record (help_fields_), so a control without help pays one pointer; write_view checks the value as the locale file's reader does (check_locale_value)

properties.name: keywords
properties.comment: The control's help index keywords: ';' separates keywords and ',' a keyword from its subkeyword. A program value a language file's keywords translate. A malformed list throws std::invalid_argument, changing nothing.
hand: a view onto the control's lazily made help record (help_fields_), so a control without help pays one pointer; write_view checks the value as the locale file's reader does (check_locale_value)

properties.name: ceremonial
properties.comment: Whether the control is a ceremonial surface (GIVEN B3-1): on it and its descendants the theme engine's ambient effects may cover more than 10 % of the window. A theme never sets it; a change repaints the subtree.
hand: written repaints the subtree (invalidate_subtree), which a generated hook without a table entry cannot say

properties.name: tag
properties.comment: Application-owned metadata or lifetime anchor (Windows Forms Tag). Deliberately inert: a write implies no rendering, layout, semantics or binding, and stores even an equal value. A view onto the control's std::any, which has no ==.
hand: a view: std::any has no ==, so it cannot be a cell; write_view stores unconditionally, as set_tag did

properties.name: focusable
properties.comment: Whether the control may receive focus; turning it off while attached gives up eligibility (focus moves on).
hand: written tells the surface root about lost eligibility, then invalidates focusability (invalidate_declared), as set_focusable did

properties.name: double_buffered
properties.comment: Windows Forms DoubleBuffered: a view over the double_buffer and optimized_double_buffer style bits, kept together; retained release is coherent either way.
hand: a view over styles_: read is either bit, write sets both through set_style

properties.name: classes
properties.comment: Style classes (T2 plan, E4) a theme's class rules select, in order, without duplicates; 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter (std::invalid_argument, nothing changed). Repeated names are dropped.
hand: a cell: prepare_write validates and drops repeated names (it adjusts the incoming list); written repaints and restyles descendants whose rules read ancestors, as set_classes did; add_class and remove_class write through the cell

not_properties.reason: an instance registration: layout writes it every arrange
